content.content: Run these checks before leaving the dock.

items: Float plan filed; VHF operational check
Fuel, water, batteries, bilge, and engine fluids checked
Safety gear aboard: PFDs, fire extinguishers, flares, sound device

content.content: Tip: assign responsibilities to crew and brief everyone.

sideB.content: Weather, safety gear, and engine/bilge/fuel systems.

content.content: Checks for a tidy, safe return and shutdown.

items: Secure lines & fenders; verify spring lines
Shut down engine per manual; close raw-water if required
Switch off non-essential electronics; shore power connected
Bilge check; trash/heads handled; decks tidied
Log times, engine hours, and any issues
